Mission Local reported that the Mission Economic Development Agency was in the process of purchasing a four-story building at 2901 16th St. to convert it into 62 permanently affordable homes. The building is two blocks east of the 16th Street BART station. MEDA planned to rehabilitate it, with existing tenants able to stay or move out during the work; the purchase depended on city approval of a project loan.
